- Difficult to Use (complaint): Touch screen, operation : Size not user friendly / Touch screen, operation / Size not user friendly
- unknown_feedback_type (unknown): no_class_found / no_class_found

Customer comment:

> i absolutely adore my 118. i really enjoy how smooth the steering wheel feels and how nicely the car drives overall. i like all the features on the 118, especially the cameras that show the street view when i am reversing and the overhead view when i am parking. the assisted parking works well, but in my opinion it still needs a bit more refinement. i have not yet built full confidence in using it, although it is excellent for backing out of my very tight usual parking space. the massage option on my routine 2 hour trips is a fun gimmick. even though the car is small compared with other models, the front seating area feels very roomy, with good interior height and a sense of space around you. the ability to drop one or both rear seats gives loads of room - i managed to take a big tv out to the country this week. and of course the standout is the engine. it is a real gem - the acceleration is fantastic for overtaking semi-trailers on narrow roads, and it is quiet as well as very economical. on the downside, i really miss my old bmw dial for choosing phone numbers and entering navigation addresses. that setup was less distracting than trying to hit tiny spots on a touch screen. the number of apps to choose from is excessive too - a simple alphabetical list view would be easier. for the seat massage, i have to scroll through about 3 screens, tap on the app, select massage, then press another button to turn it on, which is too many steps pulling my attention from the road. still, it is a fantastic car and i am delighted i bought it.

Customer comment:

> first of all i was poorly sold this car, they pushed a basic version with options added on. within a couple of minutes of getting the keys the rearview mirror was hs, and when they fixed that they also did an update on the on-board computer. since that update, it basically doesnt work anymore. i was told i need to wait for the next update, and i still havent got it yet. the windows in the retro side that were changed dont go up on their own anymore, plus the car now uses about 1 liter more since that update. the automatic gearbox doesnt change gears quickly enough or properly, and the radio signal is weak. i am really disappointed, the after-sales is not up to standard and i do not have what i actually bought. the sales, the vehicle itself and the service are no longer at the old bmw level. if i could have just handed the key back, i would have. so what are you going to offer me? im ready to swap my car.

> i haven't been happy with it because i couldn't get the options i wanted. the salesman told me bmw wouldn't give a price or a delivery date, so i had to go without them. the sport seats don't have any lumbar support and i find them really uncomfortable, with my back starting to ache after only a few miles. when i did the test drive it was in a 2 series, and those seats had lumbar support, were comfortable, and i didn't get any back ache at all. this car also doesn't have any lashing straps, and the salesman said they only come if you add the luggage net option. in the details for that option it clearly says there are 3 additional lashing eyes, so i ordered the luggage net through the salesman and picked it up from the stores, but it turned up with no lashing eyes. i didn't buy it or pay for it online either. later i read an article saying all bmw 1 series 2025 models are supposed to have a lashing eye fitted as standard. on the plus side, the car itself drives really well, with no body roll and very good brakes, and it feels like a driver's car even as an auto. i still think it would be better as a manual.

> for us this is a major step up from the previous f40 version. the ride is noticeably smoother and the cabin much quieter, with a handy increase in acceleration performance as well. fuel economy is significantly better, the regenerative braking really shines, and together with the bigger fuel tank it gives a very useful gain in overall range. the curved screen setup for driver info, sat nav, climate and so on works really well, and in our view is far better than similar systems in many other cars.

the one negative so far is the "puddle lights" in the outer door handles, which currently do not operate, even though they are fitted in the handles. these were standard and fully working on our previous 118i m sport, so why not on this one? apart from that, the car drives exactly how a bmw should and gives the impression of being a much larger model. we absolutely love it.

> gearbox has a weird glitch coming up to junctions, it wont drop into the lowest gear until i actually press the throttle, which then makes the car lurch forward in a jerky way. the bmw maps have completely stopped working and neither a map update nor doing a reset has made any difference at all. the brake pedal feel is off too, it bites at first, then there is extra travel, and suddenly the braking force ramps up a lot, instead of being smooth and progressive. getting rid of idrive was a bad move in my view, having to jab at the screen while moving is hard and really irritating. steering feels much too light. the fixed headrest is a nuisance, the angle is wrong and it keeps knocking the back of my head. i do like the seat sliding back when the seatbelt is unbuckled. handling is strong and the suspension is an improvement over the previous version, but i only got that by paying for the dynamic pack. being asked to pay around 30% more for a winter wheel and tyre package compared with the rest of europe is very annoying.

Customer comment:

> i would recommend this car to people whose sitting height is low, because it is really a lot of fun to drive.

but for those with a taller sitting height, i would not recommend it and think it should make you stop and reconsider.

the reason is the rearview mirror is oversized, it blocks the left side view and makes the left corner dangerous.

i loved the m2 i had up until last month, but even then the visibility at the left corner was dangerous.
if the rearview mirror design is not improved, i will not purchase this model again.

bmw mirrors are made very large because they are integrated with etc, and on many cars the left visibility is dangerously poor.

bmws drive very well and are great fun, but i will hold off buying another one until the bad visibility from the rearview mirror is fixed.

please, compare the mirrors with other makers and improve the rearview mirror.

i have owned many porsche 911s and caymans before, and i am still waiting for a porsche arriving this month, but their left corner visibility is very good.

in terms of driving enjoyment, bmw is more fun than porsche for me, so the mirror issue is really unfortunate.

i want to keep buying bmw in the future.
best regards.

Customer comment:

> the sensor for unlocking the doors feels too insensitive, and roughly one out of five times the lock wont react even when touching the handle. as soon as you open the door, the audio system powers up. if you step away from the car briefly while the engine is left running, the horn starts blaring, so you basically cant use the ot-lock feature. when setting a navigation destination by voice, only a small number of options is shown and one gets picked automatically, so you are unable to choose from several candidates. with the engine running at night you cant switch on the lights, so i would at least like them to be smaller. the rear gate opener also reacts poorly, probably because that sensor isnt very sensitive either. the remote key needs to be quite close for the doors to lock, the effective distance is short.

### F70-0817

- Source: Source A
- Vehicle: F70
- Market: JP
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Defect, Difficult to Use, Likes, unknown_feedback_type
- Signal types: complaint, praise, unknown

Classifications:

- Defect (complaint): Air conditioning, setting : Malfunction / Air conditioning, setting / Malfunction
- Likes (praise): ConnectedDrive and Infotainment, overall technology : Like: function / ConnectedDrive and Infotainment, overall technology / Like: function
- Difficult to Use (complaint): ConnectedDrive and Infotainment, overall technology : Not user-friendly / ConnectedDrive and Infotainment, overall technology / Not user-friendly
- Likes (praise): Drivetrain : Like: performance / Drivetrain / Like: performance
- Defect (complaint): Touch screen, operation : Malfunction / Touch screen, operation / Malfunction
- Defect (complaint): Transmission : Malfunction / Transmission / Malfunction
- Difficult to Use (complaint): Voice control / speech recognition : Not user-friendly / Voice control / speech recognition / Not user-friendly
- unknown_feedback_type (unknown): no_class_found / no_class_found

Customer comment:

> i am happy with how the car performs and with the driving itself, but i feel the control system and software still need work. in particular, these areas are below what i could recommend.

[controls and ui]
- removing the physical buttons and idrive dial has made operation while driving much worse.
- the flat panel buttons are hard to find by feel, and the whole panel sinking when pressed plus the reaction lag hurts usability.
- the ui behavior is odd, not returning to the home screen after changing modes, leaving the selection screen up.
- using the air conditioner takes several taps, which increases workload and harms safety while driving.

[driving behavior]
- from a standstill, there are times when the car behaves unnaturally, with a brief torque drop as it starts to accelerate (maybe related to auto hold release timing, mild aeb action, or dct clutch control).

[voice control]
- responses are delayed and often misrecognized, and above all, with several occupants i do not want to use voice commands, so it is not practical.
- the voice-centered ui design has not actually made operation easier.

while the vehicle itself is very appealing, the current state of the operation system and software makes it hard to strongly recommend. i hope future software updates will improve this.

Customer comment:

> too many issues
1. the rubber gasket on the rear door, even though it is a new car, was already damaged and leaking.
2. the mirrors on this new car make a squeaky noise whenever opening or closing.
3. the key that should lock the car automatically when you walk away only works maybe 1 time out of 10.
4. the digital display also goes dark: first the navigation screen on the left side blacks out, then the speedometer side goes black while driving.
5.
when that happened, i called the bmw emergency center. they asked if there was a warning light, but with the display black i cant see any warning light.
in the end they said it was fine to keep driving
...
hey, i cant see my speed, but if i get caught they will just say it was my choice to keep going.
6. at the one month check for the water leak (and the squeaking when opening/closing), the auto lock and door mirrors,
even though i mentioned it to the dealer several times, all they did was put oil on the door mirror.
3 days later it is squeaking again!
none of the other problems have improved.
7.
even though its a brand new car, its already been back to the workshop three times.

would i recommend it?? not sure??

(im debating posting this online), but i can see the dealer is at least trying to fix it.
for now just waiting and watching.

### F70-1554

- Source: Source A
- Vehicle: F70
- Market: SE
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Defect, Difficult to Use, Likes, Wants, unknown_feedback_type
- Signal types: complaint, praise, unknown, unmet_need

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Air conditioning, overall technology : Not user-friendly / Air conditioning, overall technology / Not user-friendly
- Defect (complaint): Instrument panel : Damage / Instrument panel / Damage
- Likes (praise): Touch screen, operation : Like: usability / Touch screen, operation / Like: usability
- Wants (unmet_need): Wheels / tires : Customer request: design / Wheels / tires / Customer request: design
- unknown_feedback_type (unknown): no_class_found / no_class_found

Customer comment:

> overall the car is good, but my score drops because of a few things:
* the xdrive feels too front-wheel biased. a rear-wheel bias would have suited it better and been more fun, especially since this is supposed to be a semi-enthusiast car with 300hp and a price around 500 tkr.
* there are shift paddles instead of a proper gear lever. even a sequential "fake" shift lever for the dct would have felt better than paddles. the paddles come across as a gimmick and really only make sense on the highway. when you are turning or trying to drift, the paddles are basically useless.
* there are no physical controls for climate comfort like ac or seat heating. the screen is extremely clunky for the things you change all the time, such as temperature. for everything else, the screen works great.
* the software is buggy. sometimes the infotainment and the dashboard freeze and i have to restart them by pressing and holding the volume scroll buton.

i honestly wouldnt have gone for this car if it werent for the excellent leasing offer, about 4500 sek per month for 2 years. the choice was between leasing this or buying an old tuned volvo 740. i am happy i picked this one, but when you want to have fun driving, the gear paddles and the slightly too strong front-wheel bias do make it feel a bit limited.
